topic.name: HER2
topic.short_description: Growth factor receptor overexpressed in breast and gastric cancers
topic.seo_title: HER2 in Cancer Research - Latest Studies & Findings | Your Cancer Breakthroughs
topic.seo_description: Explore HER2 cancer research, biomarkers, and diagnostics. Discover latest studies on HER2-positive breast and gastric cancers, targeted treatments, and clinical advances.
topic.seo_intro:
HER2 (human epidermal growth factor receptor 2) is a protein that plays a critical role in the growth and development of certain cancer cells. When HER2 is overexpressed—meaning cancer cells produce abnormally high levels of this protein—it can fuel rapid cell growth and division. This occurs in approximately 15-20% of breast cancers and a significant portion of gastric cancers, making HER2 status one of the most important biomarkers in modern oncology. Understanding HER2 expression has revolutionized cancer diagnosis and treatment, allowing doctors to identify which patients may benefit from targeted therapies specifically designed to block HER2 signaling.

Research into HER2 continues to advance at a rapid pace, with scientists working to develop new diagnostic tools, targeted medications, and combination therapies that can more effectively treat HER2-positive cancers while minimizing side effects. Recent studies have expanded our knowledge about HER2 mutations, resistance mechanisms, and how to better predict treatment response. For patients and caregivers navigating a HER2-positive cancer diagnosis, staying informed about the latest research developments is essential for understanding treatment options and emerging clinical trials.

On this page, you'll find the latest peer-reviewed research articles on HER2 as a cancer biomarker and diagnostic tool. These studies represent the cutting edge of scientific investigation into how HER2 testing and targeted approaches are improving cancer outcomes.

articles.title: A Phase 2b Trial of the MEK 1/2 Inhibitor (MEKi) PD-0325901 in Adult and Pediatric Patients With Neurofibromatosis Type 1 (NF1)-Associated Inoperable Plexiform Neurofibromas (PNs) That Are Causing Significant Morbidity
articles.hook: MEK inhibitor mirdametinib shrinks inoperable neurofibromas in NF1 patients
articles.summary: A drug called mirdametinib shows promise in shrinking inoperable nerve tumors in neurofibromatosis type 1 patients.

articles.title: A Randomized Trial of Neoadjuvant THP vs TCHP for HER2-amplified/Positive Breast Cancer (NeoTHERa)
articles.hook: THP chemotherapy achieves superior pathologic complete response in HER2-positive breast cancer
articles.summary: Study compares two chemotherapy combinations for HER2-positive breast cancer to determine which achieves better tumor elimination before surgery.

articles.title: Open-label Single-arm Phase 2 Trial of Trastuzumab Deruxtecan in Previously Treated HER2-Immunohistochemistry (IHC) 0 Advanced Breast Cancer
articles.hook: Trastuzumab deruxtecan shows activity in HER2-negative advanced breast cancer
articles.summary: Researchers are testing trastuzumab deruxtecan drug effectiveness in advanced breast cancer patients with HER2-negative tumors.

articles.title: Pilot Trial of Anastrozole and Palbociclib as First-Line Therapy and as Maintenance Therapy After First Line Chemotherapy in Hormone Receptor Positive, HER2-Negative Postmenopausal Metastatic Breast Cancer
articles.hook: Anastrozole and palbociclib improve outcomes in hormone receptor-positive metastatic breast cancer
articles.summary: A pilot study tests combining two drugs (anastrozole and palbociclib) to treat hormone-receptor-positive metastatic breast cancer in postmenopausal women.

articles.title: Phase I Trial of rhIL-15 Plus Dinutuximab Plus Irinotecan/Temozolomide for Children and Young Adults With Relapsed/Refractory Neuroblastoma
articles.hook: Researchers test a new immune-boosting drug combined...
articles.summary: Researchers test a new immune-boosting drug combined with standard chemotherapy to treat children with hard-to-treat neuroblastoma.

articles.title: A Phase II Trial of HER2-Targeted Therapies for Recurrent, Metastatic, or Unresectable HER2-Expressing Salivary Gland Cancers
articles.hook: HER2-targeted therapies show efficacy in advanced salivary gland cancer

articles.title: Neurophysiology of brain temperature dysregulation in humans.
articles.hook: Brain temperature dysregulation serves as biomarker for melanoma metastases
articles.summary: Brain temperature dysregulation is understudied but critical, showing distinct patterns in Alzheimer's disease, glioblastoma, and melanoma metastases that could serve as disease biomarkers.

articles.title: Neurofibromatosis type 1 with bladder neurofibroma followed by retroperitoneal malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor: a case report.
articles.hook: Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor develops after bladder neurofibroma in neurofibromatosis type 1 patient
articles.summary: A child with rare bladder nerve tumors required surgery but later developed aggressive cancer, highlighting serious long-term complications of this genetic condition.

articles.title: ARNT2 repression disrupts neuronal identity and promotes glioblastoma growth.
articles.hook: ARNT2 repression drives glioblastoma growth by blocking neuronal differentiation
articles.summary: Blocking a protein called ARNT2 in glioblastoma allows tumors to grow by preventing cancer cells from maturing into normal brain cells.
